art_direction: Teal rainy-city portrait, low amber bokeh, quiet thoughtful atmosphere.
composition_variation: Megumi Fushiguro, unmistakable unruly spiky black hair, dark teal eyes, composed thoughtful youthful face, dark high-collar school uniform. Relaxed head-to-thigh portrait, hands in pockets, no action pose. Quiet modern station after rain. Teal-blue light on face, tasteful amber window bokeh low behind shoulders, blue and warm gold pavement reflections near bottom. Upper 28 percent clean deep petrol-blue night gradient, no structures or signs there. Sparse delicate droplets only around shoulders and side edges. Blank storefronts, no signs. Polished cinematic anime art, natural teen proportions, controlled reflections and serene solitude, cool companion to Yuji sunset.
